newsitem.title: USA: NYSE April short interest rises by 52 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: NYSE April short interest rises by 52 mln shares.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Monday that short interest for the month ended April 15 rose to 3,151,504,044 shares.

This was an increase of 52,087,134 shares from the total of 3,099,416,910 shares reported a month ago. The exchange reports short interest, an indicator of investors that expect stock prices to fall, on a monthly basis.
